crossRefs.note: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says…
Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to…
She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So…
Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

translations.web: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”
translations.bsb: After she had given him a drink, she said, “I will also draw water for your camels, until they have had enough to drink.”
translations.kjv: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
translations.asv: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
